scenes.text: She woke from cryo expecting a busy station.
The station was still there. Still orbiting. Still in perfect repair.
The logs ran without a single gap for two hundred years.
The last entry was written in her own handwriting.
It said: do not wake up before you read this.
Follow Deep Space Logs for the next entry.
